prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first visual concept for the in-game Blackjack table in Stormseed's Guesstimate, a single finished environment illustration, not a UI screenshot or flyer. Landscape composition, 16:9.

Primary request: a convincing old wooden blackjack table viewed from the player's side with the camera elevated approximately FORTY-FIVE DEGREES ABOVE THE HORIZONTAL TABLETOP, looking down and across it as if the viewer is standing at the near edge. Strong coherent perspective, both the large playing surface and thick curved front edge clearly visible. This is a distinctly higher oblique view, not a low eye-level casino photograph and not an overhead plan view.

Scene: a small, inviting, rather dark old private card room, rich aged wood wall panels fading into shadow. Warm amber light from an old shaded hanging lamp pools across the green felt. Muted dark brown, forest green, tobacco and brass colors. Intimate evening atmosphere, quiet and cozy.

Main subject: exactly ONE anthropomorphic RACCOON as the dealer, standing behind the straight far edge at upper center, facing the three player positions. A mature friendly intelligent expression, realistic soft gray fur, recognizable black eye mask, cream muzzle, rounded ears; dark charcoal waistcoat with fine old gold piping over a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a black bow tie. Natural paws and credible dealing pose, with one paw calmly placing a card near the bank area. The raccoon is an integral physical character in the room, not an icon, logo, floating portrait or oversized cartoon mascot.

Table: one substantial, handsome, genuinely old mahogany blackjack table with a curved player edge and straight dealer side. Deep visible wooden thickness, irregular grain, rounded worn corners, restrained scratches and small dents, aged dark brown leather along the armrest, forest-green felt with realistic fibers and slightly worn patches. Tactile materials, soft contact shadows, restrained tarnished brass details, no glossy plastic. The tabletop occupies most of the lower two thirds of the composition and is the dominant visual focus.

Gameplay composition: exactly THREE clean player positions spaced along the near curved side, subtly indicated by three small empty betting rings in the felt. Leave generous uncluttered room for cards and later placement of our actual player avatars. No other animals and no seated player characters yet. A low wooden/brass chip reserve with a few neat stacks at the dealer's side, a modest small group of old banknotes on the left of the felt, a believable wooden card shoe on the dealer's right and discard tray on the left. Keep these secondary details small, with most of the playing area open. No huge piles of money, no poker cards standing vertically.

Style: painterly realism, like a carefully observed atmospheric oil painting of animals playing cards, with believable anatomy, hand-crafted furniture, subtle brushwork and convincing warm light. Grounded material realism rather than flat cartoon illustration or slick computer-game plastic. Dark and cozy, but the felt, wood grain and dealer's face remain clearly readable.

Constraints: one continuous, coherent table and room; a raccoon dealer behind it; three player positions; strong approximately 45-degree elevated player-side view. No captions, no title, no logos, no watermark, no menus, no UI panels, no digital buttons, no visible typography. Do not bake in a finished game interface.
